Why Yaadgar

The parts that usually go wrong, handled.

Every travel app promises "personalized." Here's what that actually means when the trip is inside Pakistan.

①

Grounded in a real catalog

Every hotel, guide and price Yaadgar suggests is a verified listing it checked against first — never something the AI made up to sound helpful.

Growing weekly — stays, guides and rides added across the north, south and cities
✓ Riverside guesthouse, Karimabad — visited & verified
✓ Private 4×4 with driver, Karimabad — verified
✓ Eagle's Nest viewpoint — route confirmed
②

Budget-aware, down to the rupee

Set a number and Yaadgar works backward from it. Swap a hotel, drop a day, add a car — the total updates instantly, no re-planning from scratch.

③

An in-trip companion, not just a booking receipt

Once you're on the road: live weather, checkpoint and closure alerts, offline maps, and one tap to reach your driver or hotel.

Babusar Pass expected to close early afternoon — plan your crossing before 1pm.
Light snow expected in Naran tonight — an extra layer is worth packing.
④

Built for Pakistan, not translated for it

Khunjerab and Deosai permits, seasonal road closures, and which valley actually suits your dates — baked into the plan, not bolted on afterward.

Khunjerab Pass — open May to November, permit included in your plan.
